entry.title: Development :: New programming language MasterBASIC
entry.dc:creator: Materion
entry.dc:subject: Development
entry.content:
Author: Materion
Subject: New programming language MasterBASIC
Posted: Tue Nov 03, 2026 8:14 am (GMT 0)

Hello,

I created MasterBASIC language for game creation for Master System. It's BASIC that compiles into native Z80 machine code and creates .sms ROM file containing game. It's easy to learn and use. Currently compiler is built for LInux but right now I am compiling Windows version :).

you can find my github with googling (as new member I can't post links unfortunately) MaterzokMateusz/MasterBASIC/releases/tag/Release1.0 that contains zip file containing compiler, tools, examples. Also you can find PDFs with Reference and Beginner's Guide. There is also .vsix file for Visual Studio Code for syntax highlighting and code suggestions.

@EDIT

If someone can post links on this forum could you please reply to this post with link to my github? Would be very thankful :)
